title: 第八章初遇鬼手门喽啰三第九章萧书生大战鬼手门喽啰一
content_zh:
就在这时，门外传来一阵急促的脚步声，管家拿着一封信跑了进来：“公子，李威将军派人送来的急信！”萧琰连忙接过信，拆开一看，脸色渐渐变得凝重。信中说，官府在黑风山附近发现了大量“鬼手门”成员的踪迹，他们似乎在寻找什么东西，而且据被俘的喽啰招供，“鬼手门”门主近期会亲自前往萧府，夺取祖传宝物。
“看来，一场大战在所难免了。”林风看着萧琰，眼神坚定，“我们必须尽快做好准备，不仅要训练家丁，还要找到《玄元秘录》。若是让‘鬼手门’得到秘录，后果不堪设想。”萧琰深吸一口气，点了点头：“好，明天开始，就麻烦林兄训练家丁。至于《玄元秘录》，我会仔细寻找父亲留下的线索，一定要在‘鬼手门’之前找到它。”
接下来的日子，萧府上下都忙碌了起来。林风将家丁们分成几组，每天清晨便开始训练，从基础的拳脚功夫到简单的阵法配合，一一悉心指导。家丁们深知局势危急，训练时格外认真，短短几天时间，整体实力便有了明显提升。
萧琰则在府中四处寻找《玄元秘录》的线索。他翻遍了父亲的书房，查看了府中的每一个角落，却始终没有找到任何蛛丝马迹。就在他快要放弃时，他想起父亲生前最喜欢在花园的凉亭里看书，或许那里会有线索。
他来到花园的凉亭，仔细检查着凉亭的每一处。凉亭的柱子、石桌、石凳，他都摸了个遍，却依旧一无所获。就在他准备离开时，目光落在了石桌下的一个不起眼的凹槽上。这个凹槽形状奇特，像是一个钥匙孔。萧琰心中一动，想起父亲生前曾给过他一枚小巧的玉珏，形状与这个凹槽颇为相似。
他连忙回到房间，从抽屉里取出那枚玉珏。玉珏通体莹白，上面刻着复杂的纹路，是父亲在他十岁生日时送给他的，说能保他平安。萧琰拿着玉珏回到凉亭，将玉珏轻轻嵌入凹槽中。“咔哒”一声轻响，石桌的桌面缓缓向上抬起，露出一个暗格。
暗格中放着一个紫檀木盒子，萧琰打开盒子，里面果然放着一本泛黄的古籍，封面上写着“玄元秘录”四个古朴的大字。他心中激动不已，小心翼翼地拿起古籍，翻开第一页，里面是密密麻麻的文字，记载着晦涩难懂的内功心法。
就在萧琰沉浸在找到秘录的喜悦中时，林风突然匆匆赶来：“不好了，‘鬼手门’的人来了，这次来了足足有五十多人，为首的应该就是他们的门主！”萧琰心中一凛，将《玄元秘录》收好，握紧手中的铁剑：“走，我们去会会他们！”
两人冲出花园，只见府门外已经聚集了大量黑衣喽啰，为首的是一个身材魁梧的男子，脸上同样蒙着黑布，腰间系着一条绣着金色鬼手的腰带，手中拿着一把巨大的鬼头刀，气势骇人。“萧府的人听着，识相的就把《玄元秘录》交出来，不然我踏平萧府，鸡犬不留！”男子的声音粗哑低沉，带着一股不容置疑的威严。
“你就是‘鬼手门’门主？”林风向前一步，手中佩剑直指男子，“想要《玄元秘录》，先过我这一关！”“不知死活的东西！”门主冷笑一声，挥起鬼头刀，朝着林风砍去。刀风凌厉，带着一股压迫感，林风不敢大意，连忙举剑格挡。
“叮”的一声巨响，林风被震得后退了两步，手臂发麻。“好强的力道！”林风心中暗惊，不敢有丝毫懈怠，再次挥剑迎了上去。萧琰则带着训练好的家丁们，与“鬼手门”的喽啰们厮杀起来。
萧琰手持铁剑，运用《流云剑法》的招式，穿梭在喽啰之间。他的剑法虽仍有些生涩，但配合着体内的内力，却也颇具威力。一名喽啰挥刀向他砍来，萧琰侧身避开，同时一剑刺出，剑尖精准地刺入喽啰的肩膀。喽啰惨叫一声，倒在地上。
不一会儿，萧琰便斩杀了三名喽啰，身上也溅满了鲜血。他看向林风与门主的战斗，只见林风渐渐落入下风，门主的鬼头刀招招致命，林风只能勉强招架。“这样下去，林兄迟早会出事！”萧琰心中焦急，突然想起《玄元秘录》中记载的一段速成心法，虽然强行修炼可能会对身体造成伤害，但此刻已顾不得那么多了。
他快速后退到一旁，闭上眼睛，按照心法记载，将体内的内力疯狂运转。一股强大的力量瞬间涌遍全身，萧琰只觉浑身燥热，经脉仿佛要被撑爆一般。他猛地睁开眼睛，眼中闪过一丝红光，手持铁剑，朝着门主冲去：“林兄，我来帮你！”
门主察觉到身后的动静，回头一看，见萧琰冲来，眼中闪过一丝不屑，挥刀向他砍去。萧琰不退反进，运用《玄元秘录》的心法，将内力全部灌注到铁剑上，一剑刺出。“叮”的一声，铁剑竟挡住了鬼头刀，门主心中一惊，还没反应过来，萧琰便一脚踹在他的胸口。
门主后退了几步，稳住身形，看向萧琰的眼神中充满了惊讶：“你竟然会《玄元秘录》的心法！”“不错，今天就让我替天行道，除掉你这个祸害！”萧琰大喝一声，再次挥剑冲去。林风见状，也重新振作精神，与萧琰联手，夹击门主。
门主腹背受敌，渐渐体力不支。萧琰抓住一个破绽，一剑刺中门主的小腹。门主惨叫一声，倒在地上，临死前眼中还满是不甘。“门主死了！”“鬼手门”的喽啰们见状，顿时乱作一团，纷纷想要逃跑。萧琰和林风怎会给他们机会，带领家丁们乘胜追击，将剩下的喽啰全部歼灭。
战斗结束后，萧府内一片狼藉，地上满是尸体和鲜血。萧琰看着眼前的景象，心中五味杂陈。这场战斗虽然胜利了，但也付出了惨重的代价，又有五名家丁永远地离开了。他走到家丁们的尸体旁，深深鞠了一躬：“多谢各位兄弟舍命相护，萧某定不会忘记你们的恩情。”
林风拍了拍萧琰的肩膀：“别太难过了，我们打赢了‘鬼手门’，保住了萧府，也保住了《玄元秘录》，这已经是最好的结果了。”萧琰点头，看向手中的《玄元秘录》，心中暗暗下定决心：“我一定要好好修炼这本秘录，不仅要保护好萧府和家人，还要用这身武功，守护更多的人，让江湖不再有‘鬼手门’这样的恶势力。”
几天后，李威将军亲自来到萧府，对萧琰和林风剿灭“鬼手门”的事迹大加赞赏，并上报朝廷，为他们请功。萧府的危机终于解除，老夫人也露出了久违的笑容。萧琰则在林风的指导下，开始系统地修炼《玄元秘录》，他知道，自己的江湖之路，才刚刚开始。

青石板路上的血迹被暮色浸成暗褐色，萧琰坐在李威将军派来的护送马车上，指尖仍在微微发颤。方才与“鬼手门”喽啰厮杀时，扇骨碰撞短刃的脆响、刀疤脸狰狞的笑，还有手臂上伤口传来的刺痛，像走马灯似的在脑海里转。他低头看着染了血的青布衣衫，书箱里那本《南华经注疏》的边角被汗水浸得发皱，忽然觉得往日里奉为圭臬的“温文尔雅”，在生死面前竟如此单薄。
马车轱辘碾过萧府门前的石狮子，家丁福伯早已举着灯笼候在门口，见他下车，慌忙上前搀扶：“公子可算回来了！老夫人从午时就站在廊下盼，眼都快望穿了。”萧琰点点头，脚步虚浮地跟着福伯往里走，穿过栽满玉兰的庭院时，晚风卷着花瓣落在他染血的袖口，倒像是给惊魂未定的场面添了几分不合时宜的温柔。
内院正厅的烛火亮得刺眼，老夫人穿着酱色缎面褙子，正坐在太师椅上捻佛珠，听见脚步声，猛地抬起头。看见萧琰手臂上缠着的白布，佛珠串“啪嗒”一声掉在地上，老夫人踉跄着扑过来，枯瘦的手攥住他的手腕：“琰儿！你这伤是怎么回事？是不是路上出了事？”
萧琰怕老夫人担心，本想含糊带过，可看着她通红的眼眶，话到嘴边又咽不下。他扶着老夫人坐回椅子，慢慢说起在岔路口遇“鬼手门”拦路、拼斗时被刀风扫伤，还有李威将军带兵解围的经过。说的时候刻意轻描淡写，可老夫人还是听得浑身发抖，抓起帕子擦眼泪：“都怪我，早知道就不让你去云台山找什么古籍！咱们萧府虽说不算顶尖世家，可也从没跟江湖匪类结过仇，他们怎么就找上你了？”
正说着，管家匆匆进来禀报，说李威将军派来的士兵还在府外等候，要亲手把“鬼手门”喽啰的供词交给萧琰。萧琰心里一紧，连忙跟着管家出去。那士兵穿着皂色铠甲，脸上还带着战场上的风霜，递过来一张折得整齐的纸：“萧公子，这是方才审讯那三个贼人的供词。将军说，里面有些事跟萧府有关，让您务必仔细看。”
萧琰展开供词，烛火下的字迹有些潦草，可每一句话都像重锤砸在心上——那刀疤脸竟是“鬼手门”的铜牌头目，此次拦路不只是为了钱财，更重要的是打探萧琰的行踪，以及确认萧府是否藏着“玄铁令”。供词末尾还写着，“鬼手门”近期在西陲一带频繁活动，专门盯着辞官归隐的官员世家，已有三家被洗劫，男丁尽数被杀。
“玄铁令？”萧琰皱紧眉头，他从未听过这东西。士兵见状补充道：“将军说，这玄铁令像是块令牌，据说藏着前朝宝藏的线索，江湖上不少势力都在找。那贼人招供，有人给‘鬼手门’递了消息，说萧老大人辞官时，曾从宫里带出过玄铁令。”
送走士兵，萧琰拿着供词回到正厅，老夫人见他脸色难看，连忙追问。听说是“鬼手门”在找什么玄铁令，老夫人愣了半天，忽然拍着大腿想起什么：“你父亲生前是有个铁盒子，锁在书房的暗格里，说是陛下赏的，不让任何人碰。可他从没说过那是玄铁令啊！”
萧琰的心一下子提了起来，转身就往书房跑。父亲的书房还保持着原样，书架上的书按经史子集排得整齐，书桌抽屉里放着笔墨纸砚，唯独书桌左侧的墙板看着有些异样——小时候他曾好奇地抠过墙板的缝隙，被父亲严肃地制止了。他按照老夫人说的，在墙板上摸索片刻，果然摸到一个凸起的木扣，轻轻一按，墙板“吱呀”一声弹开，露出一个巴掌大的暗格，里面放着个锈迹斑斑的铁盒。
铁盒上没有锁，萧琰打开一看，里面果然躺着块巴掌大的玄铁令牌，正面刻着繁复的云纹，背面是一个模糊的“令”字，摸起来冰凉刺骨。他刚把令牌拿出来，窗外忽然传来一声轻响，像是有人踩断了树枝。萧琰猛地抬头，只见一道黑影正贴在窗棂上，眼睛直勾勾地盯着他手中的玄铁令。
“谁！”萧琰大喝一声，顺手抓起书桌上的镇纸砸过去。黑影反应极快，翻身跳入院中，竟是个穿着夜行衣的女子，腰间同样系着“鬼手门”的黑腰带。那女子冷笑一声：“没想到萧书生还挺警觉，可惜这玄铁令，今日我必须带走。”说着便抽出腰间的短匕，朝萧琰扑来。
萧琰虽只学过几年粗浅拳脚，可方才与刀疤脸的厮杀让他多了几分实战经验。他侧身避开短匕，同时将玄铁令揣进怀里，抓起身边的书架挡在身前。女子的短匕刺进书架，卡在木板里拔不出来，萧琰趁机抬脚踹向她的膝盖，女子吃痛，踉跄着后退两步。
“你不是我的对手，识相的就把玄铁令交出来！”女子咬牙拔出短匕，再次袭来。萧琰知道自己硬拼不过，目光扫过书桌，忽然看见父亲生前留下的那把精铁折扇——白天与刀疤脸打斗时扇骨被砍出了缺口，此刻却成了唯一的武器。他抓起折扇，按照父亲教过的招式，将扇骨对准女子的手腕狠狠砸去。
这一下用了十足的力气，女子的短匕“当啷”一声掉在地上。她又惊又怒，伸手去抓萧琰的衣领，却没注意到萧琰另一只手已经摸到了书桌下的铜铃——那是父亲当年为防刺客装的，一拉绳子，前院的家丁就能听见动静。

content_en:
At this moment, there was a rush of footsteps outside the door, and the housekeeper ran in with a letter: "Sir, this is an urgent letter from General Li Wei!" Xiao Yan quickly took the letter, opened it, and his face gradually became solemn. The letter stated that the government had discovered traces of a large number of members of the "Ghost Hand Sect" near Black Wind Mountain. They seemed to be looking for something, and according to the confessions of the captured minions, the leader of the "Ghost Hand Sect" would personally go to the Xiao Mansion in the near future to seize ancestral treasures.
"It seems that a war is inevitable." Lin Feng looked at Xiao Yan with firm eyes, "We must prepare as soon as possible, not only to train the servants, but also to find the "Xuanyuan Secret Record". If the "Ghost Hand Sect" gets the secret record, the consequences will be disastrous." Xiao Yan took a deep breath and nodded: "Okay, starting tomorrow, I will trouble Brother Lin to train the servants. As for the "Xuanyuan Secret Record", I will carefully search for the clues left by my father, and I must find it before the 'Ghost Hand Sect'."
In the following days, everyone in the Xiao Mansion became busy. Lin Feng divided the servants into several groups and started training every morning, carefully instructing them one by one from basic boxing and kicking skills to simple formation coordination. The servants were well aware of the critical situation and were extremely serious during training. In just a few days, their overall strength was significantly improved.
Xiao Yan searched around the house for clues to the "Xuanyuan Secret Record". He rummaged through his father's study and checked every corner of the house, but he still couldn't find any clues. Just when he was about to give up, he remembered that his father loved reading in the pavilion in the garden. Maybe there would be clues there.
He came to the pavilion in the garden and carefully inspected every part of the pavilion. He touched all the pillars, stone tables, and stone benches of the pavilion, but still found nothing. Just as he was about to leave, his eyes fell on an inconspicuous groove under the stone table. This groove is oddly shaped, like a keyhole. Xiao Yan's heart moved, remembering that his father had given him a small jade jade, the shape of which was quite similar to this groove.
He quickly returned to the room and took out the jade piece from the drawer. The jade is completely white and engraved with complex patterns. It was given to him by his father on his tenth birthday, saying it could keep him safe. Xiao Yan took the jade device back to the pavilion and gently inserted the jade device into the groove. There was a soft "click" sound, and the top of the stone table slowly lifted upwards, revealing a hidden compartment.
There was a rosewood box in the secret compartment. Xiao Yan opened the box and found a yellowed ancient book inside, with the four simple characters "Xuanyuan Secret Record" written on the cover. He was so excited that he carefully picked up the ancient book and opened the first page. There were dense words inside, recording obscure and difficult inner skills and mental methods.
Just when Xiao Yan was immersed in the joy of finding the secret record, Lin Feng suddenly rushed over: "Oh no, the people from the 'Ghost Hand Sect' are here. There are more than fifty people here this time, and the leader should be their sect leader!" Xiao Yan felt shocked, put away the "Xuanyuan Secret Record", and held the iron sword in his hand: "Let's go, let's go meet them!"
The two rushed out of the garden and saw that a large number of minions in black had gathered outside the mansion. The leader was a burly man, whose face was also covered with black cloth. A belt embroidered with golden ghost hands was tied around his waist. He held a huge ghost-headed sword in his hand, which was terrifying. "People in the Xiao Mansion, listen, those who know how to do it will hand over the "Xuanyuan Secret Record", otherwise I will crush the Xiao Mansion and leave no one alive!" The man's voice was rough and low, with an undoubted majesty.
"Are you the master of the 'Ghost Hand Sect'?" Lin Feng took a step forward and pointed the sword in his hand at the man, "If you want the "Xuanyuan Secret Record", you must pass me first!" "You don't know how to live or die!" The master of the sect sneered, swung the ghost-headed sword and slashed at Lin Feng. The sword wind was sharp and had a sense of oppression. Lin Feng did not dare to be careless and quickly raised his sword to block it.
There was a loud "ding" sound, and Lin Feng was shaken back.He took two steps and his arms felt numb. "Such a strong force!" Lin Feng was secretly shocked, not daring to slack off at all, and swung his sword to meet him again. Xiao Yan led the trained servants to fight with the minions of the "Ghost Hand Sect".
Xiao Yan holds an iron sword and uses the moves of "Flowing Cloud Sword Technique" to shuttle between the minions. Although his swordsmanship is still a bit raw, it is quite powerful when combined with the internal strength in his body. A minion slashed at him with a knife, Xiao Yan sidestepped to avoid it, and at the same time thrust out a sword, the tip of the sword accurately pierced the minion's shoulder. The minion screamed and fell to the ground.
After a while, Xiao Yan killed three minions, and his body was splattered with blood. He looked at the battle between Lin Feng and the sect master, and saw that Lin Feng was gradually falling into a disadvantage. The sect master's ghost-headed sword was deadly, and Lin Feng could only barely parry. "If this continues, something will happen to Brother Lin sooner or later!" Xiao Yan was anxious, and suddenly remembered a quick mental method recorded in "Xuanyuan Secret Record". Although forcibly practicing it may cause harm to the body, he couldn't care less about it at the moment.
He quickly stepped aside, closed his eyes, and followed the records in his mind to activate the internal power in his body crazily. A powerful force surged through his body instantly. Xiao Yan felt hot and hot all over his body, and his meridians seemed to be bursting. He opened his eyes suddenly, a flash of red light flashed in his eyes, holding an iron sword, and rushed towards the sect master: "Brother Lin, let me help you!"
The sect master noticed the movement behind him, looked back, and saw Xiao Yan rushing towards him. A trace of disdain flashed in his eyes, and he slashed at him with a knife. Xiao Yan did not retreat but advanced, using the mental method of "Xuanyuan Secret Record" to pour all his inner strength into the iron sword and stab it out with one strike. With a "ding" sound, the iron sword actually blocked the ghost head sword. The sect master was shocked. Before he could react, Xiao Yan kicked him in the chest.
The sect leader took a few steps back, steadied his body, and looked at Xiao Yan with surprise in his eyes: "You actually know the mind of "Xuanyuan Secret Record"!" "Yes, let me act for heaven today and get rid of this scourge of yours!" Xiao Yan shouted and rushed forward with his sword again. Upon seeing this, Lin Feng regrouped and joined forces with Xiao Yan to attack the sect master.
The sect leader was attacked from both sides and gradually became exhausted. Xiao Yan seized a flaw and stabbed the sect leader in the abdomen with his sword. The door owner screamed and fell to the ground, his eyes still full of unwillingness before he died. "The sect master is dead!" When the minions of the "Ghost Hand Sect" saw this, they immediately became confused and tried to escape. How could Xiao Yan and Lin Feng give them the opportunity to lead their servants to pursue the victory and annihilate all the remaining minions?
After the battle, the Xiao Mansion was in a mess, with corpses and blood covering the ground. Xiao Yan looked at the scene in front of him with mixed feelings in his heart. Although the battle was won, a heavy price was paid, and five more servants left forever. He walked to the corpses of the servants and bowed deeply: "Thank you brothers for risking your lives to protect me. Xiao will never forget your kindness."
Lin Feng patted Xiao Yan's shoulder: "Don't be too sad. We defeated the 'Ghost Hand Sect', saved the Xiao Mansion, and also saved the "Xuanyuan Secret Record". This is the best result." Xiao Yan nodded and looked at the "Xuanyuan Secret Record" in his hand. Record", and secretly made up his mind: "I must practice this secret record well, not only to protect Xiao Mansion and my family, but also to use this martial arts to protect more people, so that there will no longer be evil forces like the 'Ghost Sect' in the world."
A few days later, General Li Wei came to Xiao Mansion in person, highly praised Xiao Yan and Lin Feng for their efforts in annihilating the "Ghost Hand Sect", and reported it to the court to ask for credit for them. The crisis in Xiao Mansion was finally resolved, and the old lady also showed a long-lost smile. Xiao Yan, under the guidance of Lin Feng, began to systematically practice "Xuanyuan Secret Record". He knew that his journey in the world had just begun.
The blood stains on the bluestone road were soaked into dark brown by the dusk. Xiao Yan sat on the escort carriage sent by General Li Wei, his fingertips still trembling slightly. Just now and "Ghost Hand Sect""When the minions were fighting, the crisp sound of the fan bone colliding with the short blade, the ferocious smile of the scarred face, and the stinging pain from the wound on the arm were all spinning in his mind like a revolving door. He looked down at the blood-stained green cloth clothes, and the corners of the "Commentary on the South China Sutra" in the bookcase were wrinkled with sweat. Suddenly he felt that the "gentleness" that he had regarded as the norm in the past was so weak in the face of life and death.
The carriage rolled over the stone lion in front of the Xiao Mansion. The servant Fu Bo was already waiting at the door with a lantern. Seeing him get out of the car, he hurriedly stepped forward to help: "Young master is back! The old lady had been standing on the porch since noon, looking forward to it, almost blinding her eyes. "Xiao Yan nodded and followed Uncle Fu in vain. As he passed through the courtyard planted with magnolias, the evening breeze carried the petals and fell on his blood-stained cuffs, which seemed to add a bit of untimely tenderness to the frightening scene.
The candlelight in the main hall of the inner courtyard was dazzling. The old lady was wearing a brown satin jacket and was sitting on the Grand Master's chair twisting Buddhist beads. She heard footsteps and raised her head suddenly. Seeing the white cloth wrapped around Xiao Yan's arm and the string of Buddhist beads falling to the ground with a clatter, the old lady stumbled over and grabbed his wrist with her skinny hands: "Yan'er! What's the matter with your injury? Did something happen on the road? "
Xiao Yan was afraid that the old lady would be worried, so she wanted to pass it off vaguely, but looking at her red eyes, she couldn't swallow the words. He helped the old lady sit back in the chair and slowly talked about how she encountered the "Ghost Hand Gate" blocking the road at a fork in the road, how she was wounded by the wind of a knife during a fight, and how General Li Wei led his troops to rescue the siege. She was deliberately understated when she said it, but the old lady still trembled all over after hearing it. She grabbed the handkerchief and wiped her tears: "It's all my fault. If I had known, I wouldn't have let you go to Yuntai Mountain to find some ancient books! Although our Xiao family is not a top family, we have never had any enemies with gangsters. Why did they come to you? "
Just as he was talking, the housekeeper hurried in to report that soldiers sent by General Li Wei were still waiting outside the house and wanted to hand over the confessions of the "Ghost Hand Sect" minions to Xiao Yan. Xiao Yan felt nervous and quickly followed the housekeeper out. The soldier was wearing soap-colored armor, with the wind and frost of the battlefield still on his face. He handed over a piece of neatly folded paper: "Master Xiao, this is the confession of the three thieves who were just interrogated. The general said that there are some things in it related to Xiao Mansion, so you must read it carefully. "
Xiao Yan unfolded his confession. The handwriting under the candlelight was a bit sloppy, but every word was like a heavy hammer hitting his heart - the scarred face was actually the bronze leader of the "Ghost Hand Sect". This blockade was not just for money, but more importantly, to find out Xiao Yan's whereabouts and to confirm whether the "Xuan Tie Order" was hidden in the Xiao Mansion. At the end of the confession, it was also written that the "Ghost Hand Sect" has been frequently active in the western border area recently, specifically targeting families of officials who have resigned and retired to seclusion. Three families have been ransacked and all the men have been killed.
"Xuantie Order? "Xiao Yan frowned. He had never heard of such a thing. Upon seeing this, the soldier added: "The general said that this Black Iron Order is like a token. It is said that it contains clues to the treasures of the previous dynasty, and many forces in the world are looking for it. The thief confessed, and someone passed a message to the 'Ghost Hand Sect', saying that when Mr. Xiao resigned, he had brought Xuan Tie Ling out of the palace. "
After seeing off the soldiers, Xiao Yan returned to the main hall with the confession. The old lady saw his ugly face and hurriedly asked. Hearing that the "Ghost Hand Sect" was looking for some black iron order, the old lady was stunned for a long time, and suddenly she patted her thigh and remembered something: "Your father had an iron box when he was alive, and it was locked in a secret room in the study. It was said that it was rewarded by His Majesty, and no one was allowed to touch it. But he never said it was the Black Iron Order! "
Xiao Yan's heart suddenly picked up, and he turned around and ran to the study. His father's study room remained the same, with the books on the bookshelf neatly arranged according to classics and history, and the desk drawers containing pens, inks, paper and inkstones. Only the wall panel on the left side of the desk looked a little strange - when he was a child, he once curiously picked at the cracks in the wall panel, but his father stopped him seriously. He followed the old lady's instructions and groped for a moment on the wall panel, and sure enough he felt a bulge.With a slight press of the wooden buckle, the wall panel popped open with a squeak, revealing a palm-sized secret compartment with a rusty iron box inside.
There was no lock on the iron box. Xiao Yan opened it and saw that there was indeed a palm-sized black iron token lying inside. The front was engraved with complex cloud patterns, and the back was a vague word "order". It felt cold to the bone. As soon as he took out the token, there was a soft sound outside the window, as if someone stepped on a branch. Xiao Yan raised his head suddenly and saw a black shadow sticking to the window lattice, staring directly at the Xuan Iron Order in his hand.
"Who!" Xiao Yan shouted, grabbed the paperweight on the desk and threw it at it. The shadow reacted very quickly, turned over and jumped into the courtyard. It turned out to be a woman wearing night clothes, with the same black belt of "Ghost Hand Gate" tied around her waist. The woman sneered: "I didn't expect Scholar Xiao to be quite alert. It's a pity that I have to take away this Black Iron Order today." After saying that, she pulled out the dagger from her waist and rushed towards Xiao Yan.
Although Xiao Yan has only learned basic boxing for a few years, the fight with Scarface just now gave him a bit more practical experience. He turned sideways to avoid the dagger, put Xuan Tie Ling in his arms, and grabbed the bookshelf next to him to block it in front of him. The woman's dagger stabbed into the bookshelf and was stuck in the wooden board and could not be pulled out. Xiao Yan took the opportunity to kick her knee. The woman was in pain and staggered back two steps.
"You are no match for me. If you are wise, hand over the Black Iron Order!" The woman gritted her teeth, pulled out the dagger, and attacked again. Xiao Yan knew that he couldn't fight hard, so he glanced at the desk and suddenly saw the fine iron folding fan left by his father before his death - the fan bone was notched during the fight with Scarface during the day, but now it became the only weapon. He grabbed the folding fan and followed the moves taught by his father, aiming the fan bone at the woman's wrist and hitting it hard.
This time she used all her strength, and the woman's dagger fell to the ground with a clang. She was shocked and angry, and reached out to grab Xiao Yan's collar, but she didn't notice that Xiao Yan's other hand had already touched the copper bell under the desk - it was installed by her father to prevent assassins. As soon as she pulled the rope, the servants in the front yard could hear the sound.
